verses.1: And he commanded those who were in his house to fill the bowls with food, as much as they could carry. Then he put each person’s silver in their bowls.
verses.2: And I will pour out the silver into the mouth of the small vessel. And I will also pour out the money that has been broken. I will do as Josaphat commanded.
verses.3: The morning light and the people who were sent there with their armies.
verses.4: They left the city without going far. Joseph said to those who stood at his house, “Why do you suffer harm under good circumstances?”
verses.5: Be careful of this one, who will be the one in whom Adonai will dwell. They will use him as a tool to carry out their evil plans.
verses.6: And he spoke to them about these things.
verses.7: And they said to him, “Why should Adonai speak these things to your servants? What good will it do for them to do what he says?”
verses.8: And even the silver that we found in our hoards will be returned to us from the land of Canaan. And how can we be robbed of the silver or gold that is in your house?
verses.9: Whoever is found among your servants and dies, we too will become slaves to our master.
verses.10: And he said, “Just as you have spoken, so it shall be. He who finds him will become my servant, and you will remain pure.”
verses.11: And they hurried and got up from their beds. Each person opened his bed.
verses.12: And he searched everywhere, from the large ones to the small ones. Finally, he found the plant under the pot.
verses.13: And they tore off their clothes. Then one man carried another man on his back, and the city was taken back.
verses.14: And Yehuda and his brothers came to Bethany. Joseph also went there with them. They fell down before him on the ground.
verses.15: And Joseph said to them, “What kind of deed have you done? You don’t know that I am a wise man; no one who is as wise as me can be unaware of this.”
verses.16: And Judah said, “What shall I say to my master? What can I say? The Lord has found a way to save your servants. Let us be servants to our master. We too will be servants, just as the potter has found a way to shape clay into whatever he wants it to be.”
verses.17: And Hallelujah! For the deeds of this man who found the golden vase in his hand will be a blessing for me. And you, go back to your father.
verses.18: And Judah came to him and said, “My lord, please speak to your servant. Let your servant speak to you in this manner: Do not mistreat your servant’s people, for they are just like Pharaoh.”
verses.19: Adonai asked His servants, “Do you have a father or an elder brother?”
verses.20: And he said to his father, “We have an old father, and little old children. His brother has died. He left everything to his mother and father.”
verses.21: And she said to her servants, “Bring him to me, and I will weep over him.”
verses.22: And it was said to Adonai, “The young man cannot leave his father. He left his father, and he died.”
verses.23: And he said to his servants, “If our little brother does not come down to you, then you shall not go out to see his face.”
verses.24: And it happened that we went before your servant, my father, and we opposed his words.
verses.25: And our father said, “Come back, let us be reunited again.”
verses.26: And it was said, “We cannot go down. If our little brother is with us, then we will go down. But we cannot see the face of that man. And our little brother isn’t with us.”
verses.27: And your servant, my father, said to us, “You know that I had two children with my wife.”
verses.28: And one of them came out from among me, and said, “It’s just a prey, nothing more.” But I hadn’t seen it until now.
verses.29: And you also took this along with your faces. It became a curse for them. You brought back my property in a bad condition.
verses.30: And now, as I approach your servant, my father, the boy isn’t with us. His soul is tied to his father’s soul.
verses.31: And it shall be seen that the boy is not dead. Then your servants will carry away the remains of your servant, our father, from Yagoon Sholahah.
verses.32: For your servant has wronged the boy along with my father. He said, “If I don’t bring him to you, then I have sinned against my father all these days.”
verses.33: And now, may your servant sit under the boy’s feet as a servant to my Lord. And the boy shall go with his brothers.
verses.34: How can I go to my father, when the boy isn’t with me? Otherwise, I will see what kind of evil has befallen my father.
